findings: In Chapter 1's notation the compatibility of Prop. 4 (benzecri1960_ch3.tex:604-605) holds, but not with the torus factor the proof (l.609-610, « un élément de GP(n, R) qui permute ... ») suggests: the conical isomorphisms φ_i of Ch. 1 § 3 Déf. 2 are GU-morphisms (|det| = 1), so g|F(v_{τ(i)}) must be rescaled by c_i⁻¹, c_i = |det(b_i g b_{τ(i)}⁻¹)|^{1/(n_i+1)}, and the scalars collected in t = [(c_i)] ∈ R^{+p}/R^+ (proved: prop4_produit). t ≠ 1 is needed in general: on the open segment of S(1) (two factors of dimension 0, whose cones R₊* have the identity as only conical automorphism) g = diag(1, 2) forces t = [(1, 2)] (argued, not formalized). This confirms OQ-171; it is a gap of the proof, not a falsity of the statement.

The statement's dimensions are forced, not chosen: with bases b_i : l_i ≅ R^{n_i+1}, Σ(n_i + 1) = n + 1 (Produit.pdim_eq, from E = ⊕ l_i), so the projective isomorphism F⁻¹(∏ F(v_i)) ≅ w is between manifolds of the same dimension, as Ch. 1 § 3 needs; the paper leaves this implicit.

As in BalayableSomme.lean, the statement is false as printed without « F(w) contains no line » (OQ-168, not_prop4_simplesS_finite); prop4_produit carries that added hypothesis, so the label stays unmarked.
questions: OQ-168 (OPEN): the corrected hypothesis of record; reading taken: ¬ ContientDroite (F w), as in prop4_somme.

OQ-171 (OPEN): whether the compatible form with t ≠ 1 (the GU-normalised φ_i) is the reading of record for « automorphisme compatible » here; reading taken: Ch. 1 § 3 Déf. 2 verbatim (IsCompatiblePi, which allows any t), under which the statement is proved.
« avec les notations du chapitre 1 » read as: for ANY choice of bases b_i : l_i ≅ R^{n_i+1} (the statement is universally quantified over them; their existence is exists_bases_simplesS).

kb_proposals: For an open B ⊆ S(k), Chapter 1's F(B) has a GLOBAL cone chart: FCone.coneChart of chartAt (S k) x₀ (the Opens inclusion chart, source univ, target B), source univ, target toSphere⁻¹' B (OpensCone.gcc, gccH as a Homeomorph). A linear iso matching the cones of B and B' gives an IsConeIso after normalising |det| to 1 by |det|^{1/(k+1)} (OpensCone.exists_coneIso_of_linearEquiv; derive k = k' from finrank and subst).

IsProjIso k m' Ψ for Ψ : X ≃ₜ W ⊆ S(m') reading as a linear iso after a global compatible chart: isProjIso_of_chart (get k = m' from LinearEquiv.finrank_eq, subst inside the lemma where both are variables, then isGXMorphism_of_mem_maximalAtlas). Never subst a dimension in a big theorem; isolate it in a lemma.

In a long tactic proof over PiBase with `let`-bound charts, `rw [IsProjIso.toAut_smul, piTorusAut_mk_smul]` hit the 200000-heartbeat whnf limit; moving that step into a generic lemma with B a variable (isCompatiblePi_of_transport) removed it. Likewise `obtain ⟨k, ⟨b⟩⟩ := …` on a goal mentioning PiBase timed out; `(h).elim fun k hk => hk.elim fun b => ?_` did not. Use `let`, never `set`, for the Opens family (kb 0015), and make a set-valued helper `abbrev` when it appears inside an `Opens` structure the goal compares under instance transparency.
